source_scope: same r132 runtime and corrected/logged fixture as r168, exact manifest
protocol: Contrast earlier r168 with two harness-created private Xvfb displays, two targets and two in-process MCP server objects. First held a is fixture-released, second guarded a remains held, cancel first, poll terminal and independently check second display before its own cancel; count logged delayed b requests per owner and inspect both keymaps at horizon.
criteria: Exactly one logged injection each, second hold state after first cancellation, terminal receipts and targets/keymaps retained; one attempt.
limits: Separate fixed-order allocation, two displays/targets vs same display/target r168, forced test order and delay; harness-created isolation not lifecycle integration, no stdio/physical/MAP01 or reliability claim.
